integrations.prompt: When a task changes frontend files, after task-generation and figma-intake: dispatch the e2e-plan subagent.

When a task changes frontend files, before pr-review: load visual-verify inline so it can coordinate isolated verification workers or use its single-agent sequential fallback; block unless it reports VERIFY: PASS (i.e. on FAIL or BLOCKED).
When a task changes frontend files, before pr-review: dispatch the a11y-verify subagent; block unless it reports A11Y: PASS.
While ticket-review runs on a frontend ticket, after task-generation and before e2e-plan: load figma-intake.
When a task's CONTEXT names a Figma URL, at the start of execute-task: load figma-implement.
